persona_and_vibe.emotional_archetype: Performance Pro with Tactical Frost Aesthetics
persona_and_vibe.target_experience: Single-user offline PWA designed for heavy gym environments. High-visibility numbers legible at arm's length, sweat-proof 48px+ tap targets, rapid non-blocking interactions, icy high-contrast dark visual design.

spacing_and_layout.top_bar: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-[#060913]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800/60 max-w-md sm:max-w-xl mx-auto px-4 h-14 flex justify-between items-center

elements: Active Plan Header with week/day switcher pill bar
Workout of the Day hero card with estimated time, total exercises, start CTA
Quick statistics (Weekly completed workouts streak, total volume lifted)
Rest Timer floating bar / status widget
Sweat-proof active exercise focus card
Giant weight (kg/lbs) & reps incremental logger with big + / - touch buttons
Set completion checkbox with instant visual pulse & vibration trigger (navigator.vibrate)
Technique note callout box & expandable 'Come si fa' visual guide link
Floating live Rest Timer overlay with quick +30s / skip buttons and audio chime
Plan list & Creator modal / sheet (Duplicate, Edit, Delete plans)
Hierarchical editor: Plan -> Weeks -> Days -> Exercises
Exercise fields: Name, target sets, reps/time, rest duration, technique note, reference image URL, guide link
Drag/reorder or arrow-based exercise positioning
Exercise filter / search bar
Recharts mini-graph for weight load & estimated 1RM progression
Historical logs broken down by workout session with individual set weights and reps
IndexedDB status & storage diagnostic
JSON Backup Export button & Import file dropzone
Default rest timer duration slider (10s - 300s)
Theme switcher (Inverno Dark / Light mode)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on every button, input, set row, plan card, navigation tab, timer control, and dialog
testing_and_accessibility.vibration_feedback: Trigger navigator.vibrate([100, 50, 100]) on set check off and rest timer completion

instructions_to_main_agent: Use IndexedDB (via localforage or native IndexedDB API wrapper) for robust offline persistence of plans, workout logs, and user preferences.
Ensure all tap areas are at least 48px high/wide for gym usability with sweaty hands.
Do not add any standard Vercel default styling. Use the icy dark 'Inverno' palette with glowing border accents (#0EA5E9).
Ensure complete responsive mobile-first PWA layout bounded in max-w-md / max-w-xl container so it feels like a native iOS/Android workout app on mobile and desktop.
All interactive elements must carry proper data-testid attributes for E2E validation.
